headline: Approved letter of support for grant funding for a pedestrian and bicycle bridge over I-89 at Exit 14.
summary: The bridge project has a $1.8M funding gap. Alex Armani-Munn was hired as the new economic development director and starts in November. Updates to the FY2026 annual report were also approved.
decisions: Approved the draft minutes of the September 8, 2026 meeting.
Approved updates to the FY2026 annual report after feedback was incorporated.
Approved a letter of support to the Northern Border Regional Commission for grant funding for the bridge.

plain_text:
Page 1 
Economic Development Committee 
October 13, 2026  
The South Burlington Economic Development Committee held a regular meeting at 5:30 PM 
in Room 301 of the South Burlington City Hall, 180 Market Street, South Burlington and by 
remote participation.  
Members present:  Nicole LaBrecque (Chair), Chris Carrigan (Vice Chair), Harold 
Hershberg, Paige Brochu, John Burton, Rebecca Killian, Brad Krompf, Jason Mintz  
Members absent:  None. 
Also present:  Ilona Blanchard, South Burlington Community Development Director 
(Committee Staff), Andrew Chalnick, City Council (Council Liaison), Jessie Baker (City 
Manager)  
1. The meeting was called to order by Nicole LaBrecque, Chair, at 5:30 p.m. Emergency 
exit procedures were reviewed. The agenda was approved (moved by John Burton, 
seconded by Harold Hershberg) unanimously.  
2. Comments from the Public. No members of the public were present; no public comment 
was offered. 
3. Review and Approve Minutes from Prior Meetings 
a. September 8, 2026. The draft minutes were approved (moved by Chris Carrigan, 
seconded by Brad Krompf). 
4. Updates: 
a. City Manager (Jessie Baker): 
 New Economic Development Director hired: Alex Armani-Munn. 
Selected from 26 applicants and four finalists. He lives in South 
Burlington and is currently the Executive Director of Addison County 
Economic Development Corporation. He’ll be starting in November, 
ramping up to full-time in December. 
 OnLogic acquired by Japanese firm OMRON, remaining in South 
Burlington. 
b. Staff (Ilona Blanchard): 
 Library hosting screening of Join or Die on the importance of local 
investment and engagement, Sun Nov 15th at 1pm, to be followed by a 
Community Involvement Fair.
Economic Development Committee Meeting Minutes | Page 2 
 Upcoming development conferences: Destination VT and VT 
Development Conference 
c. Member Committee Activities: 
o Harold: Relayed interest from donut shop Twisted Halo in popup 
opportunities in City Center and to better get to know the South 
Burlington market.  
1. Additional detail provided by Ilona including mention of current 
city efforts to support popups and mobile vendors including a new 
Market St permit application process. 
d. Council (Andrew Chalnick): 
o Budget season. Goal is to keep city budget level with inflation, (~3.9%).  
o Joint City Council and Planning Committee session upcoming, 
considering draft open space plan. 
5. Committee Picture 
6. Economic Development Strategic Plan 
a. Work Session: How to Tell the Story to the Community – Communicating 
Plan/Rollout.  
b. Working Groups Report: 
 Innovation District and Aviation Sector: No updates, Dynapower and 
Heritage Aviation to be included in plans 
 Hospitality/Destination: UVM continuing education offering new 
Hospitality Management certificate. Good Trade market moving from 
Burlington to South Burlington (DoubleTree) 
 Permit Expediting/Concierge Permitting Concept: Continuing to test the 
process with BETA Technologies. BETA likely moving forward with 
~$200M C-Build site plan, focused on composites manufacturing. 
 The working group structure may be reimagined once the new Executive 
Director is in place. Activity and pace will pick up once the committee 
and working groups meet with Alex. 
7. Annual Report FY2026
Economic Development Committee Meeting Minutes | Page 3

10. Adjournment 
The meeting was adjourned (moved by Chris Carrigan, seconded by Burton).
